schema: Domain-level judgment of every doc in the high-confidence removed sets (GlotLID v3 still predicts the subset language with prob>=0.9). genuine = running target-language text; genuine-other-muskogean = real Muskogean text in a DIFFERENT Muskogean language than the label; partial = target-language material embedded in majority-English page; junk = not Muskogean at all. Judged by authors from doc text (see removed_hiprob_*.json).

cho.notes: everything else = junk (pseudo-Choctaw n-grams: Slavic diminutives like koshka/ishchuk, Japanese names like Itoh/akiyoshi, Hindi song syllables like chiki-chiki, domain-typo generators)

mus.notes: everything else = junk (v-heavy strings: Vietnamese domain names, Turkish sohbet/ceket pages, tv/vt gibberish, domain-typo generators)
